datasets.name: summary_kpis
queryLines:
WITH priced AS (
    SELECT
        u.account_id,
        CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id,
        u.usage_date,
        u.usage_end_time,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'unattributed')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus,
        CASE
            WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
            WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE)
        END AS estimated_cost_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY u.account_id, u.record_id
            ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS price_rank
    FROM system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
     AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
     AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
     AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
     AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
    WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
      AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
), base AS (
    SELECT * FROM priced WHERE price_rank = 1
)

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN user_identity END) AS active_users_30d,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_dbus_30d,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0 END), 2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0D) ELSE 0D END), 2) AS estimated_cost_usd_30d,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0D) ELSE 0D END), 2) AS mtd_estimated_cost_usd,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0D) ELSE 0D END)
        * DAY(LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())) / GREATEST(DAY(CURRENT_DATE()), 1), 2
    ) AS projected_month_end_cost_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29) THEN missing_price ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_paid_rows_30d,
    MAX(usage_date) AS latest_usage_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS workspaces_seen_30d,
    ROUND(100D * COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(est_usd) FROM (
            SELECT user_identity, SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0D)) AS est_usd,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd,0D)) DESC) AS rnk
            FROM base
            WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29)
            GROUP BY user_identity
        ) ranked WHERE rnk <= 5
    ), 0D) /
    NULLIF((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd,0D)) FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29)), 0D), 1) AS top5_cost_share_pct
FROM base

queryLines:
WITH priced AS (
    SELECT
        u.account_id,

        END AS estimated_cost_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY u.account_id, u.record_id
            ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS price_rank
    FROM system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
     AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
     AND u.usage_unit = lp.usage_unit
     AND u.usage_end_time >= lp.price_start_time
     AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < lp.price_end_time)
    WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
      AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
      AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
), base AS (
    SELECT * FROM priced WHERE price_rank = 1
)

, user_30d AS (
    SELECT
        user_identity,
        ROUND(SUM(total_dbus), 2) AS total_dbus_30d,
        ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus), 2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(estimated_cost_usd, 0D)), 2) AS estimated_cost_usd_30d,
        COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) AS active_days_30d,
        MAX(usage_date) AS last_usage_date
    FROM base
    WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 29)
    GROUP BY user_identity
), recent_vs_prior AS (
    SELECT
        user_identity,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 6) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END), 2) AS last_7d_dbus,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 34) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END), 2) AS previous_28d_dbus
    FROM base
    WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 34)
    GROUP BY user_identity
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_identity,
        u.total_dbus_30d,
        u.billed_dbus_30d,
        u.estimated_cost_usd_30d,
        u.active_days_30d,
        u.last_usage_date,
        r.last_7d_dbus,
        r.previous_28d_dbus,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.previous_28d_dbus, 0D) = 0D THEN NULL
             ELSE ROUND((r.last_7d_dbus / 7D) / (r.previous_28d_dbus / 28D), 2) END AS rate_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.estimated_cost_usd_30d DESC, u.billed_dbus_30d DESC, u.total_dbus_30d DESC) AS cost_rank
    FROM user_30d u
    LEFT JOIN recent_vs_prior r ON u.user_identity = r.user_identity
)
SELECT
    user_identity,
    CASE
        WHEN cost_rank <= 10 THEN 'TOP_COST_OR_USAGE'
        WHEN COALESCE(last_7d_dbus, 0D) >= 15D AND COALESCE(rate_ratio, 0D) >= 3D THEN 'USAGE_SPIKE'
        WHEN COALESCE(last_7d_dbus, 0D) > 0D AND COALESCE(previous_28d_dbus, 0D) = 0D THEN 'NEW_ACTIVITY'
        ELSE 'BASELINE'
    END AS attention_type,
    ROUND(estimated_cost_usd_30d, 2) AS estimated_cost_usd_30d,
    billed_dbus_30d,
    total_dbus_30d,
    active_days_30d,
    last_7d_dbus,
    previous_28d_dbus,
    rate_ratio,
    last_usage_date
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN cost_rank <= 10 THEN 1
        WHEN COALESCE(last_7d_dbus, 0D) >= 15D AND COALESCE(rate_ratio, 0D) >= 3D THEN 2
        WHEN COALESCE(last_7d_dbus, 0D) > 0D AND COALESCE(previous_28d_dbus, 0D) = 0D THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END,
    estimated_cost_usd_30d DESC,
    billed_dbus_30d DESC,
    total_dbus_30d DESC
LIMIT 25
